task.title: Decision results in unreported earnings or an allocation

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the revised registration corresponding to the investigation.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Infraction: Select U - Fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 7 - You misrepresented your earnings .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the revised registration corresponding to the investigation.
BPC: Select the BPC of the claim on which the misrepresentation was made.

Work item: Select the appropriate option:
If the transaction impacts cycling claimant’s reports on a blocked claim, select 93 - Manual Pay System .
If there are no cycling claimant’s reports, select 91 - Overpayment .

Work type: Select the appropriate option:
If the Work item is 91 , select 1 - Misrepresentation .
If the Work item is 93 , select 33 - Blocked claim requiring payment .

Earnings to be allocated: Do one of the following: Warning
If wages from employment are to be allocated, select the w/c and enter the amount of the earnings to be allocated to that week. The earnings amount is rounded to the nearest dollar. The amount field must contain 4 digits with no decimal places. For example, if the client’s actual earnings were $250.49 for the week, type “0250” in the amount field. Repeat for subsequent allocation weeks. This section is completed from left to right. If more than 16 weeks of earnings are to be allocated, another Operational Centre Memo (MM06) is required.
If there are no wages from employment to be allocated, leave this section blank.

Remarks line 1: Indicate all of the following that apply:
Whether additional information is being provided on another Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction. For example, Page 1 of 3, Page 2 of 3.
URGENT: If urgent, provide reason. (e.g. URGENT approaching time limitation for penalty)
ALLOC: Other allocation information. (e.g. ALLOC 74U07-V-0550-1700-1703-0200)
FWW: If changes are required.

Remarks line 2: Indicate all of the following:
WRN: warning letter
Integrity case number.
Example

Remarks line 3: Type one of the following instructions for the ACS letter:
Send stored D-91-00-00 letter.
Add [missing fields] to D-91-00-00 letter and send.
Amend D-91-00-00, if necessary, (re: penalty limitation) and send.
Remarks line 5: Indicate your name and telephone number.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .
Go to step 10.
